about: Reviewed D4 -> D5 mappings used by the D4 class importer (d5lib/sourceimports.py). Read docs/D4_IMPORT.md before editing. relation: exact = same effect; adapted = closest D5 effect (D5's code AND numbers: evility aliases cannot carry their own values yet, see docs/D4_IMPORT.md); lookalike = name/description only, behaves differently; omit = not imported. desc: in-game description; leave it out to keep the D5 evility's / skill's own text, which states what the effect really does (with its real numbers).
